 Order

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.2172/2022 pending before the XXXVII Additional C.M.M. Court, Bengaluru, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 506 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in unison would submit that during the pendency of the petition, the parties to the lis have settled their dispute in M.C.No.4891/2022, before the IV Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru and they have parted ways with.

entities.text: Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The conditions of the settlement includes the closure of the matrimonial proceedings impugned in the subject petition.

A copy of the memorandum of settlement filed under Section 89 of CPC r/w. Rules 24 and 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) Rules, 2005,
is filed along with a memo to that effect.

3. The settlement insofar it narrates the closure of the present proceedings reads as follows:
NC: 2023:KHC:20956 "5.

In view of the settlement arrived between the parties the petitioner has agreed to cooperate for the closure/quashing of the C.C.No.2172/2022 filed under Section 498-A, 504, 506 of IPC r/w Section 3 & 4 of DP Act, pending on the file of 37th ACMM, Bengaluru.
6. The respondent has agreed to sign NOC to remove his name form the Birth Certificate of their son Kashwin A."

In the light of the afore-extracted memorandum of settlement for having arrived at settlement of the dispute between the parties, I deem it appropriate to obliterate the proceedings initiated against the petitioners, as the allegations are ones punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 506 of the IPC and not against the State.

4. For the aforestated reasons, the following:
ORDER i. The Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii. The proceedings in C.C.No.2172/2022 pending before the XXXVII Additional C.M.M. Court, Bengaluru, stand quashed.

Sd/-
